synthesis.headline: Management dropped key acquisition guidance while core financials demonstrate consistent annual revenue and profit growth.

points.text: Management issued specific targets for net debt to EBITDA of 2.3-2.3x and 350cr cost synergies in May 2026, but dropped them on subsequent calls.
Annual revenue grew steadily from 33498.0 crore in Mar 2021 to 58462.0 crore in Mar 2026.
Annual PAT improved consecutively across the period, reaching 11509.0 crore by Mar 2026 alongside strong cash from operations of 12419.0 crore.
Operating margins remained relatively stable, registering 28.2% in Mar 2026 compared to 25.3% in Mar 2021.

bull.text: Consistent annual PAT growth culminating at 11509.0 crore in Mar 2026.
Strong balance sheet health with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.04 as of Sep 2026.
Solid cash generation with cash from operations reaching 12419.0 crore in Mar 2026.

bear.text: Management dropped quantitative guidance metrics regarding acquisitions initially promised in May 2026.
Qualitative expectations regarding tax rates and revenue growth remain unverifiable.
